experiment_template.research_question: Does tokenizer-fitted exact-generation state improve native evidence selection after recycling without projection-size failures?
stop_conditions: Any eviction removes objective identity or breaks fact provenance.
Any presented projection exceeds the frozen state-token cap.
Shared provider or instrument failure pauses unstarted cells.

records.falsifier: Any selected state projection exceeds the cap, any state-cap condition terminates an otherwise runnable episode, provenance breaks, treatment completion degrades, or the fixed paired native outcome target is not met.
records.mechanism: Build only at the selected generation, measure the projection with the provider tokenizer, and deterministically evict oldest outcome or evidence facts until the exact projection is at or below the frozen token cap. Preserve objective identity, newest facts, provenance, and all model-token accounting.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; tokenizer-fitted exact-generation post-recycle state with structured terminal submission common.
records.statement: A tokenizer-fitted exact-generation state projection preserves useful recent process facts without causing state-cap episode failure and improves useful completion.

records.research_question: Does tokenizer-fitted exact-generation state improve native evidence selection after recycling without projection-size failures?
stop_conditions: Any presented state above 1,024 tokens, more than four fitting measurements for one render, unused-generation measurement, unmatched presentation, or state-cap episode failure is an instrument failure.
No acceptance or successor selection changes from observed outcomes.
No within-round changes, replacements, source refresh, threshold changes or lucky reruns.
Pause unstarted cells on shared provider or instrument failure and retain every attempted outcome.

success_criteria.scope: Eight exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K fitted-state development pairs; no full cohort, larger window, confirmation, repair correctness, transfer or clearance claim.

records.claim: The first control exhausted its 2,048-token response cap before any fitted-state treatment ran, so H14 has no outcome or exposure evidence in round eight.
limitations: The length-limited output is model behavior at the frozen cap; it does not estimate state utility.

records.next_action: Add exactly one model-visible, budget-accounted concise-action correction after an incomplete output, common to both arms, then retain tokenizer-fitted H14 in a new frozen round.
